description: Enlarges a video (or a clip of it, at most 60 s) 2x or 4x with Real-ESRGAN, frame by frame, on this machine; results up to 4K. Reads anything ffmpeg reads, including OpenCV MPEG-4 (mp4v); writes H.264 MP4 with the sound kept. Every frame goes through the model, so expect about 0.5 s per 480p frame on a recent CPU. The first call installs ONNX Runtime (about 113 MB) and downloads the model (5 MB). Needs ffmpeg installed.

end.description: Seconds (default: the end, at most 60 s after start)

model.description: general for live action (default), anime for animation (about twice as fast)

name: video_upscale
title: AI video upscaling
